title: Rewrite the dispatch, merge and wave role docs onto the bee pane verbs
verify: test "$(rg -c 'herdr (pane|tab|agent|workspace) ' skills/bee-herding/references/role-dispatch.md skills/bee-herding/references/role-merge.md skills/bee-herding/references/wave-runs.md | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END {print s+0}')" = 0 && .bee/bin/bee knowledge check
action: Per D2, a cold role reads one vocabulary. The verbs landed in commit e5698a9 and thc-7 widened the envelope — READ `packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/herding/pane_verbs.rs` for the exact subverbs, flags and envelope keys; never guess a key. `pane layout` rows now carry `x`,`y`,`width`,`height`; `pane list` rows carry `id,label,tab,cwd,command,foreground_cwd,agent_status,agent_session` (`--with-status` fills agent_status on tmux). Replace every herdr command in the three role references with the bee verb that performs the same action — the live list is `rg -n "herdr (pane|tab|agent|workspace) " skills/bee-herding/references/role-dispatch.md skills/bee-herding/references/role-merge.md skills/bee-herding/references/wave-runs.md` (re-run it, do not count on numbers). Mapping: `herdr pane current --current` → `bee herding pane current` (envelope `result.{pane_id, tab_id, workspace_id}`; the `--pane <own id>` form in §8.5 collapses to the same verb); `pane rename <id> <label>` → `bee herding pane rename <id> <label>`; `pane layout --pane <id>` → `bee herding pane layout --pane <id>` (`result.panes[]` with pane_id/x/y/width/height — the chat-pane rule 'smallest x, ties smallest y, excluding own' maps 1:1); `pane read <id> --source recent --lines N` → `bee herding pane read <id> --lines N`; `pane send-text <id> "…"` → `bee herding pane send-text <id> "…"`; `pane list --workspace <ws>` → `bee herding pane list [--workspace <ws>] [--with-status]` (rows carry foreground_cwd/agent_status/agent_session — the §4 anomaly scan and the §4 dead-session test keep their exact fields); `pane split <id> --direction … --ratio … --cwd … --no-focus` → `bee herding pane split …` (same flags minus --no-focus, which the verb always applies; `result.pane_id`); `pane close <id>` → `bee herding pane close <id>`; `agent start <slug> --kind <k> --pane <id> --timeout 60000 -- <args>` → `bee herding agent-start <slug> --kind <k> --pane <id> -- <args>`; `tab list --workspace <ws>` → `bee herding pane tab-list`; `tab focus <id>` → `bee herding pane tab-focus <id>`; `herdr-result`/JSON field reads (`.result.pane.tab_id` etc.) → `bee herding result <path>` (relative to `result`) over the verbs' envelope. Keep every rule, order, refusal and report line of the roles exactly; only the command spelling and the parsed field names change. Where a role says "herdr workspace" as a place (including `dispatch-prompt.md` and `merge-prompt.md`), say "the pane workspace (herdr workspace or tmux session)". The quick-reference tables at the end of role-dispatch.md and role-merge.md get the same treatment. In `SKILL.md` frontmatter, the `herdr-cli` dependency becomes a transport note: herdr is required when `herding.transport` is herdr, tmux on PATH when it is tmux. Do NOT touch role-bootstrap.md (thc-4 owns it). Proof: the verify's rg count must be 0 and `bee knowledge check` green; also walk role-dispatch.md §1–§9 once as a reader and record in the cap line that every command is a bee verb.
